source_rule: Only values a source actually asserts may be used. active_like and inactive_like require the source to carry that meaning; they are never a softened restatement of a confident annotation.
prohibition: structural state is NEVER derived from motif geometry (see section 17 policy)

states.definition: source explicitly qualifies the state as active-like
source explicitly qualifies the state as inactive-like
different copies in one entry carry different states

states.aggregation_rule: excluded from state-stratified tables; included in state-agnostic same-site-class aggregation

states.definition: state is not a meaningful attribute for this record

transducer_rule: Transducer presence is a stratification field only. A G-protein-bound structure may well be active, but that inference may not be used to assign a state.
